content:
mel: FYI  hosting a visiting designer at 2pm (Theo). Hell bring a vintage hardcase briefcase with fragile electronics and says hes bringing his emotional support cockatiel, 'Pixel'. Need badge + a short, quiet seat and a plan for the bird and the fragile briefcase.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: Theo Martin, 1 visitor + 1 pet (cockatiel), ETA 14:00, host: mel. Please confirm pet policy and allergy notes. Check-in: https://intranet/checkin/pixel321

sam: Cute name. Quick checks: 1) Pets must be announced and cleared by People Ops. 2) Bird should be in a covered carrier in common areas. 3) Fragile items: have host confirm if we should escort the briefcase straight to Conf A.

olivia: Also note we have a staffer with severe bird allergy in Product. If Pixel will be in public spaces, we need to route guest to a quieter lobby bench and keep Conf A reserved or use an outdoor entry spot. Mel, can Theo keep the bird in the carrier while inside?

mel: He said Pixel is very calm and used to travel in a soft-sided carrier. Theo is happy to keep Pixel contained except for a short supervised moment if needed. Hes offered to keep the briefcase in his car, but the briefcase is where the prototype lives and hed prefer it inside.

harper: For the fragile briefcase: Facilities can bring a padded dolly and reserve Conf A for drop-off. Front desk should print a badge note: "Fragile: escort to Conf A". For the bird: require covered carrier and no bird out-of-carrier policy in shared rooms.

ops: Ops: Conf A reserved 13:50:00 for safe drop-off. Facilities will meet at reception with pad dolly and a small soft mat. We approve bird in carrier in lobby bench area only. Please add allergy flag in calendar.

frontdesk-bot: Action items: 1) Badge note: "Fragile briefcase - escort to Conf A" 2) Allergy flag set (Product - bird allergy) 3) Pet note added: carrier-only in indoor spaces.

sam: Mel, please ask Theo to confirm carrier dims and whether Pixel will be unrolled at any point. Also request that any bird food or treats stay sealed and in the hosts bag to avoid crumbs.

mel: On it. Quick Q: seating for Theo  bench or soft chair? He might be on-site for ~45 mins.

olivia: Soft chair preferred so Theo can remove coat and not crowd the bench. Well keep bench clear as a second option if allergies make that necessary.

harper: I'll prep a soft lounge chair near the north alcove and a small side table for the carrier. Facilities will place an "Allergy: bird" notice in the hallway for the 14:00 block.

mel: Theo confirmed: carrier dims 60x40x35cm, Pixel will remain in carrier indoors. He is fine with Conf A for the briefcase drop-off. He also said hes bringing a small thank-you pastry box for the team (nut-free).

ops: Note on pastry: if sealed and nut-free, front desk can accept and label, place in common fridge if needed. If unsealed, keep in hosts conference room.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor checked in at 13:58. Badge printed. Note: "Fragile briefcase - escort to Conf A" and "Pet: carrier only".

sam: Theo arrived. Pixel quiet in carrier. Facilities helped with the briefcase and placed it on the padded mat in Conf A. Host signed the acceptance log.

mel: Thank you all! Quick follow-up for the playbook: add a 2-line pet policy reminder (carrier-only, allergy flags) and a fragile drop-off flow (escort + padded mat + acceptance signature). Saves the scramble. :thumbsup:
